name: gh-issues
conclusion: gh-issues (Escalate) specifies 4 of 5 categories: 5 autonomy limits, 1 clarification rule, 5 approval gates, 4 escalation rules; none for validation rules. Strongest: autonomy limits.

autonomy_limits.conclusion: 5 autonomy limits (5 mandatory, 0 advisory; 0 conditional), mostly prose: curl and GitHub REST API only; dry-run stopping before Phase 4; auto-processing issues without confirmation.

statements.quote: IMPORTANT — No `gh` CLI dependency. This skill uses curl + the GitHub REST API exclusively.
Display the table and stop. Do not proceed to Phase 4.
Auto-process ALL listed issues without asking for confirmation

clarification_rules.conclusion: 1 clarification rule (1 mandatory, 0 advisory; 1 conditional), mostly prose: owner/repo when no git remote found.

statements.quote: If not in a git repo or no remote found, stop with an error asking the user to specify owner/repo.

approval_gates.conclusion: 5 approval gates (5 mandatory, 0 advisory; 3 conditional), mostly prose: which issues to process; first watch-mode poll; uncommitted changes in working tree.

statements.quote: Ask the user to confirm which issues to process:
Wait for user response before proceeding.
Watch mode note: On the first poll, always confirm with the user (unless --yes is set).
Wait for confirmation. If declined, stop.
If `--yes` is NOT set and this is not a subsequent watch poll: ask the user to confirm which PRs to address ("all", comma-separated PR numbers, or "skip").

escalation.conclusion: 4 escalation rules (4 mandatory, 0 advisory; 4 conditional), mostly list: GitHub authentication failures; curl errors; unreachable remote origin.

statements.quote: If curl returns an HTTP 401 or 403 → stop and tell the user: > "GitHub authentication failed. Please check your apiKey in the OpenClaw dashboard or in ~/.openclaw/openclaw.json under skills.entries.gh
If curl fails or returns any other error → report the error verbatim and stop.
If this fails, stop with: "Cannot reach remote origin. Check your network and git config."
